comment: Chromium clamps in the block flow: the lines of nested blocks (with margins, borders) count, the ellipsis ends the line the count reaches N at, the clamped height ends there without the margins after it, and the blocks after the clamp point (with overflow: visible, painted) are as tall as their first line; a block with its own formatting context, an inline-block or a float keeps its lines out of the count; an empty block after the clamp line keeps the ellipsis; floats below the clamped height are not enclosed.
